full_request: 덕테이프 포스터를 만들어줘. 문구는 “서로 다른 속도”만 넣어줘. 어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게.

procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic session, I verified the explicit pinned input bytes and read packet.json, case.json, review_rules.md, critic_rubric.md, the declared ratio policy, the two pinned scripts and all five pinned native-evidence manifests. The packet contains no source assets or protected layouts. I then called tools.view_image via functions.exec for each exact poster asset with detail="original", and emitted each returned image using image(...,"original"), one poster asset per invocation. The completed visual sequence was M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All 15 were visually inspected before the first transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. Hash checks and PNG header/chunk inspection were separate supporting checks, not substitutes for viewing. No OCR, contact sheet, image editing or regeneration was used. No ambiguity revisit was needed. I claim no runtime thread ID; session_id is null for the runner to bind.
procedure.source_assets_note: packet.source_assets is empty; no supplied source asset was omitted.
procedure.protected_layouts_note: packet.protected_layouts is empty; the five read manifests are native-evidence manifests, not protected-layout measurement manifests.
